verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes a first-run wizard that guides users through model credentials, channels, and defaults. The quick-start material covers only running a Docker command and claims a fast path to a first conversation. Provider connection is described as adding an OpenAI provider with a custom Base URL, with no guided onboarding flow shown, so none of the story's specific capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files
